entities.name: Dev
entities.rationale: Handwritten 'Dev' label at the left of the board; the developer commits code to CodeCommit. Not inside any box.

entities.name: CodePipeline
entities.rationale: Icon at top (869,184) labelled CODEPIPELINE. Sits above CodeCommit and CodeBuild as the orchestrator of the stages; outside the VPC box.

entities.name: CodeCommit
entities.rationale: Icon at (794,333) labelled CODECOMMIT. Source repository stage where the developer commits code; outside the VPC box.

entities.name: CodeBuild
entities.rationale: Icon at (956,334) labelled CODEBUILD. Build stage that produces the container image; outside the VPC box.

entities.name: CloudFormation
entities.rationale: Icon at (808,506) labelled CLOUDFORMATION. Deploy stage, annotated with '#100' (parallel customer deployments) and the steps '1) Change Set, 2) Approve, 3) Execute'; outside the VPC box.

entities.name: Registry
entities.rationale: Icon at (808,675) labelled REGISTRY. Amazon ECR registry holding the application container image output by CodeBuild; outside the VPC box.

entities.name: VPC
entities.rationale: VPC icon at (1103,452) on the top edge of a white rectangular box. This box is the container that holds ECS, IAM and ALB (one VPC per customer).

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Icon at (1031,629) labelled ECS. Drawn inside the VPC box; the task definition deployed by CloudFormation.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Icon at (1181,631) labelled IAM. Drawn inside the VPC box; IAM role and permissions deployed by CloudFormation.

entities.name: ALB
entities.rationale: Icon at (1106,786) labelled ALB. Drawn inside the VPC box; application load balancer deployed by CloudFormation.

visual_connections.description: Green arrow from the 'Dev' label to the CodeCommit icon: the developer commits code to the repository.
Short green arrow from CodeCommit to CodeBuild: the pipeline moves the commit to the build stage.
Long green diagonal line from below CodeBuild down to the Registry (ECR) icon, with the arrowhead at the Registry: CodeBuild outputs the container image to ECR.
Green arrow from the CloudFormation icon to the left edge of the VPC box: CloudFormation deploys the ECS task definition, IAM role and ALB into the VPC.
